Step 14 + 04: OD flow x flood risk overlay

svg.text: Pipeline: 17 processing steps in Python (NumPy, Rasterio, GeoPandas, scikit-image). Full source in src/step_00..step_16. Configuration in src/config.py.
Resolution: 1 km (MAP friction surface template). All rasters snapped to a common grid in Step 00. Cost-distance via MCP_Geometric (skimage.graph).
Reproducibility: Set AOI environment variable (benguela/bie/huambo/moxico/moxicoleste), run notebook. Results regenerated from raw inputs.
